description: This Dart file defines the 'RecordsRepository' class which interacts with an API client to fetch medical records data. It contains a method to retrieve user-specific records and handles fallback in case of an ApiException.

classes.name: RecordsRepository
classes.description: Repository class responsible for fetching medical records data from API endpoints.

methods.name: getMyRecords
methods.description: Fetches the authenticated user's medical records, with fallback to a general endpoint if the first request fails.
